$schema note: Eight DeckCraft output themes. bg/ink/accent/secondary are the four swatch colours, in that order.

themes.name: Modern
themes.specimen: Series A, one slide at a time
themes.rule: One accent blue, everything else greyscale. Left-aligned titles, no rules, no shadows.

themes.name: Professional
themes.rule: Serif headings, navy authority, thin gold rule under every title. Page numbers always on.

themes.name: Dark
themes.rule: Never pure black with pure white type. Cards lift with a lighter fill, not a shadow.

themes.name: Light
themes.rule: No colour at all. One idea per slide, huge margins, light weights only.

themes.name: Editorial
themes.specimen: The case for buying less software
themes.rule: Magazine logic: two-column body, pull quotes, italic captions. Titles can run three lines.

themes.name: Technical
themes.rule: Charts are the slide. Mono labels, axis rules at 20% ink, amber reserved for the outlier.

themes.name: Bold
themes.specimen: We grew 4× without a sales team
themes.rule: Type fills the frame edge to edge. Six words maximum. One slide, one colour flip.

themes.name: Warm
themes.rule: Rounded corners, photography over flat colour, hand-set captions. Good for founder stories.
